articles.summary: New features promote responsible AI use through in-the-moment student support, tailored reading experiences and resources that build essential AI literacy skills McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH) (“McGraw Hill”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced new artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities within McGraw Hill Connect®, its digital learning and course management solution for higher education. Enhancements within Connect include Learning Coach, a conversational AI tutor launching in select courses over the coming months, as well as a new Translation Tool and resources to help students build AI literacy. 1.
